apply.cip: Federal rules require your name, date of birth, address, and an identification number before an account opens. We ask once, here, with the reason next to each field.
apply.path.ssn: I have a Social Security number
apply.path.ssn.sub: The usual path for U.S. citizens and permanent residents.
apply.path.itin.sub: An IRS tax number works in place of an SSN.
apply.path.foreign_status: I do not have either yet (passport and student documents)
apply.path.foreign_status.sub: Open with a passport and your school documents. No SSN needed.
apply.path.minor.sub: Teen accounts are signed with a parent or guardian.
apply.path.branch_assist: I would rather do this with a banker
apply.path.branch_assist.sub: We hold your place and a banker finishes it with you.
apply.checklist.title: What you will need
apply.notes.title: Good to know
apply.doc.gov_id: A government photo ID: driver license, state ID, military ID, U.S. passport, or permanent resident card
apply.doc.gov_id_itin: A government photo ID: passport, consular ID, or state ID
apply.doc.address_proof: Proof of your Austin address: lease, utility bill, or UT housing letter
apply.doc.w8ben: W-8BEN acknowledgment, which you check in step 2
apply.doc.school_id: Your school ID or state ID
apply.doc.guardian: A parent or guardian, with their own government photo ID
apply.doc.any_id: Whatever ID you have, even if it is expired or incomplete
apply.doc.any_address: Anything with your Austin address on it
apply.note.savings_member: Savings opens with $1 and is what makes you a member.
apply.note.anyone_can_join: Anyone can join UFCU. You do not have to be a UT student.
apply.note.no_ssn_needed: No SSN needed to open; you can add one later if you get one.
apply.note.zelle_ssn: Zelle requires an SSN. Wires and transfer services work in the meantime.
apply.note.no_ssn_needed_later: No SSN needed to open; you can add an SSN or ITIN later.
apply.note.zelle_ssn_intl: Zelle requires an SSN. Use a wire or an international transfer service for now.
apply.note.new_address_video: A new address often means a five-minute video call with a banker before the account opens.
apply.note.guardian_signs: A parent or guardian signs with you at the University Branch, so this path finishes in person.
apply.note.banker_sorts: A banker sorts the rest with you in person. Nothing here is a dead end.
apply.f.w8ben: I am not a U.S. person and will complete a W-8BEN
apply.why.name: Your legal name is one of the four items federal rules require before an account opens.
apply.why.dob: Date of birth is required to confirm you are the person on the ID.
apply.why.email: We send your account documents and disclosures here, not paper.
apply.why.phone: We call this number only to reach you about your application or a fraud alert.
apply.why.address: A physical address is required before an account opens; a P.O. box cannot be used.
apply.why.occupation: Occupation helps us spot activity that does not match the account later on.
apply.why.affiliation: Affiliation is optional and only shows which membership route applies.
apply.why.ssn: An identification number is required before an account opens; for a U.S. person that is a taxpayer ID.
apply.why.itin: An ITIN is the taxpayer ID the rule accepts when you do not have an SSN.
apply.why.passport: For a non-U.S. person the identification number can be a passport number.
apply.why.country: The issuing country tells us which document standard to check the passport against.
apply.why.w8ben: The IRS asks non-U.S. persons to certify foreign status on a W-8BEN instead of a W-9.
apply.trust.title: Identity readout
apply.trust.note: In production these checks map to a KYC vendor and the core; today they are simulated.
apply.detail.doc.ok: The sample ID scanned clean and the security features matched.
apply.detail.face.ok: Your selfie matched the photo on the ID.
apply.detail.consistency.ok: Your name, date of birth, and address line up across the documents.
apply.detail.consistency.new: Your address is only a few weeks old, so a banker will confirm it.
apply.detail.watchlist.ok: No match on the sanctions and watchlist files.
apply.detail.minor: Under 18, a parent or guardian signs with you in person.
apply.route.instant.title: Verified. Your accounts can open now.
apply.route.instant.body: Nothing else is needed from you for identity.
apply.route.video.title: A five-minute video call with a banker
apply.route.video.body: One item needs a human look. Pick a time today and a banker at the University Branch will confirm it with you.
apply.route.branch.title: Finish at the University Branch
apply.route.branch.body: This path is signed in person. Bring your documents and your parent or guardian.
apply.branch.hours: Monday to Friday, 10 AM to 4 PM
apply.accounts.sub: Verified once, applied to every account in this bundle.
apply.disclosures.title: What you are agreeing to
apply.disclosure.esign.sub: You agree to receive statements, notices, and disclosures electronically. You can ask for paper any time.
apply.disclosure.agreement.sub: The rules for the account: fees, how deposits clear, and UFCU's right to apply your deposits to what you owe it.
apply.disclosure.w8ben.sub: You certify you are not a U.S. person for tax purposes and will complete the IRS form.
apply.decision.approved.title: You are a member. Your accounts are open.
apply.decision.approved.body: Your account numbers arrive by email in a few minutes. Nothing else is needed today.
apply.decision.needs.title: One more thing and you are done
apply.decision.notyet.title: Not this account yet, and here is what works instead
apply.next.title: Next steps
apply.next.deposit.title: Move your paycheck here
apply.next.deposit.detail: Give your employer routing number 314977405 and your new account number. UT campus jobs change it in Workday.
apply.next.digital.title: Enroll in digital banking
apply.next.digital.detail: Set up the app first; every other step below happens inside it.
apply.next.atm.title: Fee-free ATMs on campus
apply.next.atm.detail: Student Services Building, Gregory Gym, PCL, and RLM take deposits. The Union ATM does not.
apply.next.zelle.title: Zelle needs a Social Security number
apply.next.zelle.detail: Until you add one, pay friends by wire or another transfer service. You can add an SSN or ITIN later.
apply.next.credit.title: Credit Builder Loan
apply.next.credit.detail: The money sits in your savings while the payments get reported to the bureaus. You get the deposit back at payoff.
apply.next.switch.deposit.title: Re-point your direct deposit first
apply.next.switch.deposit.detail: Everything else is easier once the paycheck lands here.
apply.next.switch.autopay.title: List your autopays and move them
apply.next.switch.autopay.detail: Rent, phone, insurance, subscriptions. Work from last month's statement so nothing is missed.
apply.next.switch.keep.title: Keep the old account open one statement cycle
apply.next.switch.keep.detail: It catches anything you forgot to move before you close it.
apply.next.switch.close.title: Then close the old account
apply.next.switch.close.detail: Ask for the balance by check or transfer, and get the closure in writing.
apply.err.path: Pick the path that matches your documents.
apply.err.street: Enter your street address. A P.O. box cannot be used.
apply.err.state: Use the two-letter state code, like TX.
apply.err.occupation: Enter your occupation, or write Student.
apply.err.itin: An ITIN is 9 digits and starts with a 9.
apply.err.passport: Enter the passport number exactly as printed.
apply.err.country: Enter the country that issued your passport.
apply.err.w8ben: Check this so we can file your W-8BEN.
apply.err.docs: Add your ID and a selfie, or press Use sample.
apply.err.enrollment: Add your I-20 or DS-2019, or press Use sample.
apply.err.verify: Run the check so we can show you the readout.
apply.err.slot: Pick a time for the video call.
apply.err.products: Savings is the membership account and stays in the bundle.
apply.err.esign: Agree to receive your documents by email.
apply.err.agreement: Agree to the Membership and Account Agreement.

apply.stage1.progress: Checking the details you gave us...
apply.outcome.verified.title: You're verified.
apply.outcome.verified.body: Your details matched what we're required to check. Nothing else is needed for identity.
apply.outcome.stepup.title: One more thing to confirm it's you.
apply.outcome.stepup.body: We couldn't confirm everything from your details. Instead of sending you to a branch, we can finish online with a photo of your government ID and a quick selfie. Our identity partner checks them in seconds.
apply.outcome.video.title: Almost there. A banker will finish this with you.
apply.outcome.video.body: One detail needs a quick look from a person. Pick a five-minute video call, or stop by the University Branch.
apply.outcome.branch.title: Let's finish this together at a branch.
apply.outcome.branch.body: A banker will finish this with you in person, and you will leave with the account open.
apply.outcome.branch.orVideo: Or book a five-minute video call instead
apply.demo.how: Demo: how the system decided (not shown to members)
apply.credit.approved.title: Approved for the UFCU Visa
apply.credit.approved.step: Your card arrives by mail in about a week; activate it in the app when it lands.
apply.credit.notyet.title: Not yet for the credit card
apply.credit.notyet.reason: We can't approve the UFCU Visa today because there isn't enough credit history yet. That's normal for a first account, and it's exactly what these two options fix.
apply.credit.alt.builder.title: Credit Builder Loan
apply.credit.alt.builder.body: The money sits in your savings while the payments get reported to the credit bureaus. You get the deposit back at payoff, and this one is approved today.
apply.credit.alt.secured.title: Secured Visa
apply.credit.alt.secured.body: The same UFCU Visa, backed by a deposit you set aside. Rates are capped by federal credit union rules, and it becomes a regular card once you have a history.
apply.credit.comeback: Come back in about six months and we'll look again.
